reviews.review_msg: Psych 201w with Shawn Tan is by far one of the easiest courses. You don't need to attend the lectures asides from the first ones just to get a general idea of the course.This course is tutorial based so attend your tutorials !! This is one of the courses that if you follow the instructions and put a bit of effort, then you will get an A.
Lectures seemed pretty pointless which was good because they were awful. Your TA is really all that matters for this course.

His lectures are clear and is easy to follow. He assigns quizzes every week, so get ready to read the textbook. During lectures he gives good feedback on quiz questions that most people got wrong. Attendance is not mandatory for the lecture as he hosts a zoom call that is also recorded and uploaded. Overall, nice prof.
I was worried about this course but it ended up being very straightforward and fair graded, the prof wants everyone to do well and if you complete the coursework you will do just fine

Psyc 201w with Dr.Tan was awesome, he was very accommodating to all students and was super nice. I was very afraid for this class but it was so easy and the grading criteria is painfully detailed and clear. If you follow all the instructions for the assignments, do your research participation, and do the weekly quizzes, you will get an A.
While the lecture slides may not be the most fun, this grading criteria is super clear and if you follow what he says you will get an A in the class.

I took this class online in 2020. I would recommend taking it online if you can! Cause in person you actually have to conduct the experiment. The lectures were dry but the midterms and final were easy because he gave you the terms that are on them. However, it's your TA that makes a huge difference in this PSYC class cause they grade ur paper.

He has a strong accent when explaining stuff but he recorded lectures so we could look at them to see what we missed. You only needed to be in-person for tutorials as he streams in-person lectures over zoom. I never used the "required" textbook. He struggles the most explaining concepts involving math but for the rest he explains them adequately.

Dr.Tan is a great person, but he has a strong accent which makes him hard to understand. On top of that, he is not very good at explaining concepts as he pretty much gives textbook definitions. The quizzes for this class are easy though and there was no midterm or final.

Shawn tan is a good professor. Sometimes it can be hard to understand him but his slides are clear and he is very clear about the structure of the assessments and what will be on there. The assessments come directly from the slides. He records his lectures which I love and in-person attendance isn't mandatory.

Professor Tan is a nice person, but his explanations of certain concepts are unclear and confusing. He also has difficulty answering student questions during lectures. Student participation is expected during lectures, which leaves the room quiet. But, his lecture slides are always posted, and his notes are clear.

Horrible. He's a nice guy but not a good professor. He could not explain was he was teaching well. Class attendance was always at 50% or less. The way grading is done is not helpful and doesn't actually show if you know the material or not. Would not recommend at all.

If you read the textbook and go to your labs you can get a good mark in this class no problem. The midterm and final were a breeze. Lectures are a waste of time because she practically reads from the textbook. Labs were harder, but you basically just have to go and you'll be fine.
I don't know what everybody's talking about, Natasha was awesome.  She sets you up to succeed, and if you bother to do the work, you'll do well.
Her TA's suck, they are nit picky, snobby, and hard markers. Bad combo!
This prof is no good! One of the worst teachers I have had in my 3 years in University. The fact that she is nice does not change the fact that she should NOT BE TEACHING... aviod her at all costs!!
Awesome prof! Totally helpful and always had time for questions.

Dr Ghosh made research methods fun. I liked that she used the text as it was easier to understand when I actually read it. She's really helpful and totally approachable. I agree, she should teach 300 level courses!

Yes, she copies straight out of the text book but lots of professors do that. Final exam was difficult. I enjoyed the class and thought she was very helpful when you approach her for help. I wish she taught 300 level Psych courses because I enjoyed being in her class.

she is copying the material from the book, useless to go to class, especially she talks fast and u cant write anything down. hardmarker, oh my god, average for one the assignment was 6 something out of 10. Is she retaliating or what?
Worst instructor I have had. she is not interested in the material she coveres, only follows exactly what's on the book, and the final exam was not fair at all.

She rushes.  DO not expect to learn much in lecture.  her slides are the textbook word for word.  If you study the text during the time u are scheduled for the lecture, you would learn more. She seems really nice and cheerful, but that doesnt help students learn the cirriculum.

Sarcastic and stubborn, difficult to approach. Repeats the textbook word-for-word in lecture, however she is fairly cheerful and you know exactly what to expect. Puts all slides online and checks WebCT regularly

By far one of the best professors I had. She is very friendly and encourages questions in class. She is also very approachable for help. Her final exam was hard and the wording for some of the questions was confusing. However, I still enjoyed the class and hope that she teaches some third year courses next semester. I HIGHLY recommand her!
super easy....she's so cool too...if you need to take psyc 201...take it with her....you'll get at least a B if you tried
very nice! she made the course easy to understand, and was very helpful throughout the whole course. really great teacher.

Everything substantial about this course is thanks to the TAs. His lectures are NOT helpful for weekly quizzes and exams. I recommend leaving after the weekly quiz and basing your notes off textbook. The many assignment deadlines overlap each other, and the cumulative quiz was an exam, impossibly hard unless you already took Psyc Stats.
Very unclear marking rubric and a very difficult, tedious person to talk to. Lectures are just him reading off his notes for 3 hours straight.

Responsible, organised. Lecture content is a lot but he makes it easy and simple to understand. Lecture slides are easy to digest. Attending lectures will make sure you do good on quizzes and the final.
HW are worth 60%, even a 5% assignment takes forever to finish. Tutor grades all the assignments so your grade depends a lot on your tutor.

Dr Blanchard is a lovely prof! As long as you stay on top of the weekly topics and your research project you should do fine. There were a couple tricky writing assignments but I had a great TA who made those much more tolerable. Lectures are jam packed with information, and I managed to do fine on quizzes by just skimming the text book most weeks.

hard course, make sure you know your material (read the textbook and take notes). dr. blanchard does his best to make the lecture engaging and the material interesting. he's nice and all grading criteria were properly explained. the TA graded the writing assignments and research report and gave good feedback. go to the tutorials! [summer 2022]

His writing is illegible!
 He speaks well and that's really all you can go on.
 
 He talks about a lot of useless things that are not even on the exam. He goes beyond the class requirement, which is usually a good thing but he does it in such a manner that the material confuses you even more.
 
 His exams are difficult. You must read the questions

He lectures well but his writing is terrible. We spent  much time on things not important and no time on the important, exam staff. The exams are level 300, very difficult. He gives scenarios that u have to read few times to understand. Also, he focused on areas that are studied in another class. I would not take another class with him.

Do not ever take a class with this professor.  He is difficult to understand, his writing is extremely difficult to read, he doesn't use the textbook and his lectures are all over the place.  The prof also changed our syllabus and added extra assignments. NO CLAIRTY on anything. The TA's are nothing but grammar police.

Very difficult prof. Stay away from him unless you need a challenge! Does not use the textbook, no overheads, talks way too fast, and hard hard exams! Psyc201 was waay too statistical, should be intro to methods, not stats!
typicall psyc prof ...he is nice though
i got killed by the final..
Occasional overhead notes,illegible writing,knows his material,sometimes funny
CRANKY, ok-hard tests, talks fast, writes bad, tells good jokes, knows his stuff
Excellent TA, knows his stuff, makes attending tutorial interesting, is a fair marker, and is always available to help you.  Likes to drink beer at the pub.

One of the better TA's you're likely to find, no matter the discipline.  Very passionate about the course material, despite it's being technical and thick.  Great sense of humour.  Honest (and thus tough) marker!  But at the same time gracious if you have extenuating circumstances and need extensions.  Highly recommended!
Extremely harsh grader, but overall a good TA. She's really friendly and easy to talk to. She actually cares about her students which is nice :b

Daniella is the best T.A I had this semester hands down. I was kind of scared because this is my first semester at SFU but Daniella proved to be super helpful and my fears turned out to be very unfounded. I'll give her a 100% anytime, anyday!
Awesome TA.

Daniella is by far the best TA I've had at SFU. She is super helpful, always taking time out of her day to make sure all of your questions are answered, whether in office hours, tutorial, or by email. On top of all that, she is super sweet and caring.
Awesome Ta!

Daniella is a remarkable TA. She answers your emails right away and is always available for help. She goes the extra mile to make sure you understand the material, and makes labs fun. I would recommend signing up for a tutorial with her.

Extremely helpful.  Goes out of her way to make tutorials interesting and exciting.  Always on hand to give advice, and would schedule advising times outside of office hours.  Overall, an enthusiastic, fun and professional individual.

her slides are well organised but her lectures were boring as hell, for the first few weeks she ended a bit early and later on started stretching things out so it would end on time. tutorials usually ended an hour early every week and seemed pointless bc it was mostly reiterating lecture content. i didnt touch the textbook once and it was fine
Dr. Lim is a nice prof but her final exam was much harder than expected. Expects a lot of detail for assignments
Dr. Lim is a nice prof but her final exam was much harder than expected. Expects a lot of detail for assignments

She kept lectures interesting and expectations on assignments and due dates were very clear. I would recommend reading and studying the textbook because she does incorporate it a fair amount, but overall a solid professor.
A lot of homework. Grading is tough depending on TA. They expect very specific answers so pay attention to the rubric. i barely made it but super do-able. Pretty strict grading system too.

Her lectures were engaging and fairly entertaining. She gives fair warning for all upcoming assignments with clear instructions. However, the tutorials felt like a waste of time; we were always let out super early and felt like there was nothing to talk about that wasn't said in the lecture already.

Lim's lectures are clear and easy to follow but man are her lectures boring / disengaging. Her TA's can be unreliable and inconsistent with grading, it seems like the prof and TA's are not on the same page. Doesn't seem like she really cares tbh. The TA's do not prepare you for the research paper adequately, so stay on top of it yourself.

I think you're missing out if you don't take the course with her. Office hours were helpful, lectures were well organized and weekly quizzes weren't hard. I genuinely want to take another one of her classes.

There are a few things to note when taking her class. If you have tutorial at 8:30am, you have to hand in your research assignments in person, on campus, at 8:30am. She was not clear that we had to pay for iclicker subscription either. Her late penalty is fair and she is easy to talk to, she is just unclear on important course aspects

Since 201 is a 4 credit class it is a lot of work, but manageable if you stay ahead. I liked Dr. Lim as she was helpful, caring and knowledgable. Weekly i-clicker tests weren't too bad, tougher final exam than I thought it was going to be for multiple choice. Good class and prof.

Was my TA for PSYC 201W. I did an initial outline for an essay incorrectly, and he was extremely helpful when I emailed him for advice. Ended up with a 90% and was told my paper was publishable material. If he hadn't responded to my questions about potential topics, I would have failed
Not an easy or particularly interesting course but Evan is a terrific instructor.
Dr Caldbick overall was a decent prof. He wasn't a tough grader although the cutoff for an A+ for summer 2024 was 96.7%. The class at times felt a bit unorganized but overall was an easy course

Dr. Caldbick was very approachable, which was good because I found the instructions on assignments to be pretty vague and I almost always had to clarify what was expected.  However, he provided the written answer questions that would be on the final a few weeks before the exams, which was great.  Overall a pretty nice prof.

Just had to come back here and update since graduating and I will never stop hyping this prof. If you've made it through uni by memorizing and spitting info back out on an exam then good luck. If you have common sense and can grasp the basics of the topic w/o getting stuck on the details then you will appreciate her.

If you are like me, sick of students who believe they are so smart b/c other profs just get them to regurgitate info, you will love and appreciate her teaching. She is a no-silly business, no-excuses kind of gal and I love that abt her. Sick of people getting extensions, using AI and not getting caught etc. Dr. Gordon cares about what matters.
the most unorganized prof I have ever had. avoid at all costs

The toughest instructor since the dawn of mankind. I learned to not expect her to be understanding of whatever tough situation I'm in as she is totally indifferent and uncaring about her students' success. She replies to emails once in a blue moon & never checks canvas emails. She ruined psychology for me after having gotten stuck with her twice.

This class felt like the equivalent of two courses. Was not clear about grading criteria, would make the quizzes impossible to get a good grade on and contradicted the textbook. TA's ditched us at end of sem and would answer "idk" to questions asked. We never got our final assignment back and I got a b+ but have no idea how. Skip lectures
Lot of content is subjective, and "correct" answers depend on her opinion, rather than what the textbook says. Very confusing, and makes it hard to study for her exams.
Great lectures. Curve was very generous. Hard but doable class.
may god have mercy on your soul because iris wont

Please don't take anything with her I beg of you. Her quizzes make no sense. she changes instructions for things, and then acts like she never changed them at all. I'm a person who thinks she can tough out bad profs, but this one is REALLY NOT WORTH IT. save your time and sanity

If you want to stay sane, avoid Iris Gordon at all costs. My mistake was thinking it would be best to take this course with her to get this class over with asap, than having to take it in a future semester later on. Now that I have finished Psyc 201W with Iris, I would have much rather waited for another professor to teach this course.
she's a terrible prof, avoid.

Changed the criteria for our final project 2 weeks before it was due and NEVER told the TA's [it stressed tf out of everyone]. She squeezed assignment 4, the final project and final exam into the last week of class. Her quizzes were impossible to get a decent grade on. My TA also disappeared in the second to last week of the semester.

If you are interested in the subject and planning to attend lectures - take the course with her, because the lectures are actually engaging (and are kind of mandatory if you want to stay in the loop and get all the good tips and clarifications). 
If you just need to pass this course with least amount of work, then pick someone else.

the entire course was messy and disorganized. TAs ghosted everyone in the last two weeks. due dates are all over the place and the final project was unnecessarily confusing. quizzes were difficult despite being open book.
My favorite Prof lol
All TAs disappeared a week before the finals, I hate this class so much. Every 1 star reviews are true, take it seriously.

She changes the due date for a lot of the quizzes and assignments, we end up having to hand in 3 quizzes, 1 assignment and the final project all in 1week (and a finals in the same week as the final project). All the 1 star reviews are NOT JOKING, don't take any class with her.
i don't even go here but i agree
reading the reviews like my morning newspaper
group project.......why
Don't listen to the bad reviews. The course is hard but the final is super easy. Hilarious lectures.

For the love of god Iris needs to be stopped from ever teaching another class in her life. TA personally told me that the teaching staff had no clue what was happening and another TA confessed she got a 4/10 on the open book online quizzes. Seriously the most ridiculous class, so unorganized, sent me on a depressive spiral. Run.

All the TAs disappeared a week before finals ended?? gives us a study guide for the final the but quizzes were a lot more helpful?? whole class was super messy... and she made some very... bad comments over the semester.

I took both 102 and 201 with her and YIKES. Terribly disorganized, pushes back due dates until the final week, contradicts the textbook on textbook reading quizzes, doesn't communicate with TAs (who all mysteriously vanished in the final 2 weeks?), and can't make her mind up.

201: Disregard the study guide she gives you and just study the quizzes.

Worst psychology professor at SFU. Doesn't communicate with TAs, changes her mind for assignments every damn second, and has the most ambiguous quiz questions ever. Assignments and research project are hard to complete when even she doesn't know what she wants. Don't even get me started on all the mistakes she makes, claiming it's an "IT issue."

just completed the exam and lifted the reason for 70% of my stress this semester. do yourself a favour and just wait for another prof to teach the course. NONE of her instructions were clear and she changed the FINAL PAPER CRITERIA 2 weeks before it was due. Also the due dates are dependent on your tutorial timing

I had 102 with her last year and it was just as bad as this course. Very unorganized and that made everyone feel very stressed. While these reviews are reflective of how her students feel about her, I encourage everyone to submit their course experience survey to let Admin know of your thoughts and feelings as well.

changed criteria, instructions, and due dates so much that we had a paper due, our final project due, and a final exam due all in the same week. don't get me started on the horrible project that shape-shifted more than a skin-walker

an absolute joke of a class. all the reviews have basically summed up my feelings towards this course but its just sad seeing how so many people agree on these things. the quizzes do not reflect what the textbook says, instead the answers are what she deems correct. very unorganized, changes due dates and instructions last min.

-2/10. No one knows what we're doing ever. Constantly changing due dates. Constantly changing instructions. Unethical prof. Ridiculously unclear reading quizzes. She pushed back so many assignments and still made us all finish them when we were working on our final project. Should not be teaching. Don't take.

THE TA'S LITERALLY DIPPED A WEEK BEFORE THE EXAM AND WHEN THE GROUP PROJECT WAS DUE AND ASSIGNMENT #4!!!!!! AND THE REASON WAS "DUE TO EXCEEDED ALLOTTED HOURS".... ERM..... HOW IS THAT A PLAUSABILE EXCUSE LIKE WHY U LEAVING US BEHIND TAKE US W UUUU!!!!! WHO GONN MARK NOW HUH?? DR. GORDON???!!! I HOPE NOT CUZ WE ALL COOKED IF YES!!
So utterly shameful of her to change an INDIVIDUAL PROJECT into a GROUP PROJECT last minute and have everyone scramble at the end.

How should I even start this rate. 

THIS COURSE IS THE DEFINITION OF "HUH???!!!" You will be confused all the way through this whole semester, and when u think u finally got it....... SIKE NO U DIDN'T! Be careful for gr projects, read the book, AND look back on the quiz questions for the exam (TRUST). 

RUN FOR THE HILLS PLS SAVE URSELF!!!!!!!!

RUN!!! Iris is actually UNETHICAL & she has caused me psychological trauma that i will endure for the rest of my life. Instructions ALWAYS changing/unclear. she is such a passive aggressive prankster. all TA's suspiciously ran away & ghosted us 2 weeks before final...we were left with no support, trauma, and the need for therapy. What a joke.

lectures don't help you, she's extremely disorganized, quizzes are tricky and answers are based on what she deems correct. students & TA's were in constant confusion as deadlines were constantly changing and instructions were so vague that everyone would interpret them differently. i have never been more confused or exhausted in a class.
I'm mentally distressed because of her quizzes. No amount of textbook knowledge can get you full marks

Deadlines are always changing, quizzes and her wordings are ambiguous (several answers seem to exist for a single vague question). Confused about the final project throughout the whole term. A genuinely curious question: How are we to work on a single paper as a group when we started with different hypotheses, methods and results? Still confused

Her lectures are entertaining but the information in them isn't relevant to assignments or quizzes. Just read the textbook & save yourself the confusion. Quizzes are full of trick questions and the assignment schedule is disorganized & confusing. If you get a good TA you'll be alright (they are the ones doing the grading) otherwise you should avoid

GUYSSS whatever u do, DO NOT TAKE IRIS GORDON. she will give you PTSD if you take a course with her!! she changes her mind about deadlines/assignments every nanosecond, and talks about essential oils during lectures. she makes the class more difficult then it has to be and she is the definition of a Karen. Her exams are impossible to do well on.

LISTEN TO THIS REVIEW!!! Do not take PSYC201W with this prof, wait until another prof is teaching it. I cannot stress this enough. If you are like me and think that the reviews are 'people are being dramatic' you are wrong. I have never experienced this level of disorganization and misinformation before. She should pay for my therapy bills.

Horrible professor who would grade your assignments hard, even the comments sometimes will confuse you. Changing everything on the rubric or what she wants us to do. Always inconsiderate of the assignments she gives us as well. Her quizzes are super hard, she contradicts the book and not even half the things she talked about are on the quizzes.

Don't get me wrong, her group projects suck, but I enjoy all the other aspects of her class. Minimizes exams and places heavy weight on the weekly quizzes, and I really enjoy her lectures. Don't understand all the hate for her... she tries really hard for her students to do well and offers lots of help.

Iris Gordon is the worst professor. She will give you vague and ambiguous instructions for assignments, and then criticize you for doing things wrong (*cough anything to do with the research project*). Textbook reading quiz questions make no sense and negate reading the textbook at all. So unclear/confusing. Iris Gordon is the bane of my existence.
GOOD LUCK, she made my semester rough and I would never take her again. All I have to say is Good Luck
Iris Gordon has made my life miserable for the past two semesters. Fun person. Terrible prof. AVOID AT ALL COSTS.

Whatever you do, make sure to not take this class with Dr. Gordon. Her quizzes are impossible to do well on, with vague questions and "correct" answers which contradict the textbook. You pretty much have to be in her head to know which answer *she* thinks is the right one. Everything else is such a mess. AVOID!!! AVOID!!!
Sure her lectures were entertaining, but was the rest of it worth it? No.

STAY FAR AWAY I DON'T CARE BUT STAY FAR AWAY. I'd rather drop this classes because she is awful like I don't even know where to start. Quizes each week,6 writing assignments worth 6% and good luck with the instructions. Group project is a joke you can't use anything from previous semester and you won't know if its been done until the mark is posted

She does not teach the material on the quizzes, and the quiz questions themselves are worded awfully. She uses a textbook but constantly contradicts stuff in the textbook and also creates new terms out of thin air to teach in a university-level class. None of her instructions are clear, but she expects us to know and do everything perfectly.

The worst professor I have ever had. Literally the worst. I cannot caution you enough to NOT take this course with her. She will accuse everyone of plagiarism, take forever to release grades, and also only release the guidelines for written assignments the week before they're due. Good luck!

Iris Gordon gives funny and interesting lectures! But that's about it. She is very disorganized, makes facts out of thin air, and disputes what is written in the textbook, making it very hard to study for quizzes or tests. She is also very disorganized. Please stay away from her if you can!

took 201 with her in spring 2023. truly the most traumatizing experience ive ever had in a class. run while u can. accuses students of cheating in front of the whole lecture, does not respond well to feedback, does not REPLY TO EMAILS, does not communicate with her teaching team. truly the blind leading the blind cus nobody knew what was going on.
dropping out of psyc

Rambles fast in lectures, provides a general outlook on material but youll def need to read textbook to fully understand for tests. Big on academic dishonesty. Was very disorganized w deadlines in this course, currently taking psyc102 w her & shes better for that one. Dont let previous reviews scare you, her class is doable w good time management!

I found the course overall not too hard BUT, Iris is not good. Her quiz questions have many errors and lack clarity. HER GRADING SCALE IS DIFFERENT! She says she does not scale, however, she uses her own cutoffs that makes it harder to get a high grade.

A side note is that her humour is self-deprecating, I feel bad for her.

Worst professor I've ever had & is the only prof that has worsened my mental health over the semester by refusing to accommodate me, a registered CAL student who REQUIRES accommodations for my disabilities from all my profs. thought it was ableism until I came on here and saw all the other awful reviews. Also rudely accused me of things I never did

Everyone is saying she is bad I don't know why. Yeah her courses are hard but she tells you basically exactly what you are tested on. The classes are hard but as a teacher she is great. Engaging and tries to make it fun. Always answers emails and hears you out if you need a regrade/extension.

Iris Gordan is constantly going on irrelevant tangents during lecture and is extremely anal. She is constantly changing due dates, the TAs express how she never communicates with them and somehow, without fail, she manages to connect the material of every lecture in a research methods class to autism. her opinions are also questionable at best.

Very disorganized. TA always mentioned how she doesn't receive the information in time to give us proper feedback to answer any questions we have. Grades for quizzes and papers are always delayed. Seems to care more about academic integrity violations than actually helping students learn. Rubrics are never available till after grades are released.

Extremely disorganized.
Always pushing back quiz and assignment deadlines; Never uploads quizzes or assignment to canvas on time.
Quiz marking is inconsistent with the textbook and her words.
Doesn't give Teaching Assistants detailed instructions on upcoming assignments because of her disorganized schedule.

probably the worst prof i have ever had. She is so rude and gives attitude, you would never expect that from a prof. course material is is not dependent on teaching style significantly, but Jamal's attitude made it hell. I would not recommend her to anyone, after an incident that happened i had written her up and told i was not th first to complain
I don't know why everyone's complaining. I thought she was a good prof. I was really stressing about this class but I studied from the textbook and received an A+! Definite GPA booster.

The content is boring as hell but she tries her best to make it interesting. She gives LOADS of examples which is great and always makes sure the class is keeping up by asking us how we're doing with the content and if we need to review anything. Sometimes she gets confused about what she's talking about. but her exams are fair. The project is hell

She is knowledgable about the subject,but doesn't not how to convey it to students.When one doesn't understand smtght,she'll reexplain it in the same manner as the 1st time.So unless u got it on the spot,u won't get it!She is PICKY abt late assignmts/forgotten sheets (e.g grading rubric).Assignmts take time to do,and most aren't worth it mark-wise.
The marking scheme was fair but it completely reliant on who your TA is. Jamal attempts to engage the class, but sometimes lecture could drag.

The course material is somewhat dry, but she made it interesting and her lectures were  enjoyable. The marking and tests were fair overall, but the tests were based around concepts, so don't just memorize definitions. I also found that she was extremely helpful and friendly when I went to her office hours.
The prof is good, she has definitely improved. Her explanation is clear and she is here to help you. Plus, she is friendly.

The prof is one of the better ones I've had so far. She seems to be quite passionate and open-minded. The course was quite interesting and Jamal threw in a handful of jokes at times. The marking was fair, I think, though I found the exams extremely difficult. Don't study definitions. Instead, make sure you understand the content.
Tried to make the bland topics fun.  Easy to listen to her talk because she's usually energetic.  Seemed to be interested in what she was teaching.

Good professor, straightforward style, nice powerpoints.  The course content is too basic though.  My cousin is in grade 3 and she knows at least half the concepts for doing scientific experiments taught in this course.  The experiment you get to do by yourself is cool though.

Lecture was soooooo boring. OMG. i stopped going in the third week.  textbook is a must - all the material is relevant. Exam wording is tricky, you need to be very careful. Online study guide was helpful.

Jodi is an excellent prof. Her exams are not easy, but they are fair as she prepares you for them extensively with very organized notes and     informative lectures. Labs are VERY useful, and mandatory for a good grade. If you want a great prof, an informative class, and a good experience, take 201 with Jodi. P.S Kallista is the best TA ever!!!

Great prof! Really knows how to explain the material in a way so that students will remember and understand it. Highly organized notes and references the text. Exams are very fair, though you do need to study! She went the extra mile due to a snow day and gave an extension on the essay and reduced the exam. Good communication via email. TAKE HER!

OMG A prof that uses the textbook!  All the material is pretty much straight from the text, and there is an online study guide thing (although not very good).  I found that what we needed to know was clearly laid out for us so it was easy to do well on the exam if you read the chapters and put some effort into making sure you knew it.
The exam is difficult. :(

Kevin is an awesome professor. Went through information so clearly and slowly making a seemlingly unteeresting class my favorite one this semester. Oh, and he's so sexy that even if the class was boring, it would still be enjoyable to go to!! :)
A very good prof - encourages and answers questions. Gives great examples/case studies.The course itself is a bit dry and boring.

Dr. S is an amazing professor!!! She was extremely kind and shockingly, very thorough with her rubrics. For the massive, semester-long research paper, her rubric broke down exactly what had to be done and provided us with instructions for what to write for each sentence. Lectures can be heavy and the textbook is absolutely necessary!! Hard final!

Dr. Schimanski is definitely one of the kindest professors I have had throughout university so far. She truly cares about her students and wants them to succeed. Always approachable and very informative. She makes what could be a rather dry subject matter pretty interesting. There are biweekly quizzes that aren't super easy but are entirely MC.

Lesley seems to really care about her students. Her lectures a little dry but they're informative as she tries to break down confusing topics. There is quite a bit of writing involved, as you are writing your research paper throughout the semester. Her biweekly quizzes might have some questions straight from the textbook, so keep a lookout on that!

Second time shes been my prof and shes great! Lectures are boring but shes willing to meet and explain concepts in office hours, as well as provides time to go over the projects. Multiple choice quiz every other week, as long as you study the questions in the textbook and lecture slides you'll be fine. make sure to be able to apply the concepts!
so considerate and reasonable, one of those profs that explains things in amazing ways, highly reccommend!
